characters.continuity: DC Comics Modern Post-Crisis / New 52 / Rebirth
characters.summary: Jefferson Pierce is a metahuman who generates and projects powerful bio-electric blasts and force fields, combining hand-to-hand combat prowess with ranged electrical offense. He can fly via electromagnetic levitation and manipulate electrical grids.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to having his powers drained or grounded by specialized insulation
limitations: Requires stamina to maintain massive electrical output

sources.supports: Basic origin, powers, and membership in the Justice League and Outsiders.

feats.claim: Generated massive electrical discharges capable of shutting down multiple vehicles and knocking out armed squads simultaneously.

campaignTags.claim: Can generate and project high-voltage electricity.
Manipulates electrical fields and power grids.
Can fly using electromagnetic manipulation.

unknowns: Exact upper limits of electrical output vary across different writer interpretations.

characters.continuity: DC Comics Modern Post-Crisis / New 52 / Rebirth
characters.summary: David Hyde is a ruthless mercenary and assassin who utilizes heavily armored diving gear equipped with high-powered weaponry, most notably his helmet's sweeping optoelectronic optic laser blast. He is a master tactician and skilled underwater combatant.
weaknesses: Human physiological limits when separated from his armored suit
Obsessive vendetta against Aquaman can cloud tactical judgment
limitations: Suit relies on external power sources and ammunition stores

sources.supports: History, suit capabilities, and rivalry with Aquaman.

feats.claim: Fought Aquaman to a standstill on multiple occasions using his high-tech suit and arsenal.

notableResults.note: Defeated repeatedly by Aquaman's superior physical strength and marine telepathy.

campaignTags.claim: Operates extensively underwater with specialized diving equipment.
Suit provides complete underwater life support.
Wears high-tech advanced combat and diving armor.

unknowns: Exact metallurgical composition of his New 52 armor.

characters.summary: Jaime Reyes is bonded to an alien scarab, Khaji-Da, which forms an advanced symbiotic battle suit around him. The suit can generate weapons, shields, wings for flight, and adapt to counter enemy powers, though Jaime must negotiate with the scarab's autonomous programming.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to magic and specific high-frequency vibrations that disrupt scarab technology
limitations: Scarab autonomy can sometimes override Jaime's conscious control during high-stress situations

sources.supports: Origin, scarab symbiosis, weapon creation, and flight.

feats.claim: Sliced through energy fields and damaged advanced Reach technology using scarab-generated weapons.

conditional.ability: Full combat suit manifestation and weapon creation

campaignTags.claim: Deploys energy wings from the scarab armor for flight.
Armor constructs various high-tech weapons and tools on demand.
Wears an alien symbiotic powered suit.

unknowns: Extent of the scarab's full Reach database access during early bonding phases.

characters.id: dc:Blue Beetle (Jaime Reyes)|Khaji Da Full-Control Beetle
characters.summary: In this state, the Khaji-Da scarab takes full operational control of the armor without Jaime Reyes's hesitation or moral restraint, unlocking maximum tactical efficiency, heavy ordnance deployment, and faster threat neutralization.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to magic and anti-Reach frequencies
limitations: Leaves the human host mentally sidelined during operation
characters.formDifferences: Removes human hesitation, maximizes weapon output, and utilizes ruthless alien combat tactics.

sources.supports: Scarab capabilities and autonomous control functions.

feats.claim: Accessed restricted Reach military databases and combat sub-routines autonomously.

campaignTags.claim: Utilizes scarab-generated wings for flight under full system control.
Operates fully integrated alien powered armor.
Scarabs act as semi-sentient AI managing the host body.

unknowns: Long-term mental strain on the host after prolonged autonomous use.

characters.summary: Michael Jon Carter is a time-traveling hero equipped with stolen 25th-century technology, including a force field belt, flight ring, and energy blaster. He relies on advanced tech and future knowledge to handle threats, often maintaining a comedic public persona.
weaknesses: Relies entirely on external 25th-century technology which can malfunction or deplete power
limitations: Force field can be overloaded by sustained heavy attacks

sources.supports: Origin, 25th-century equipment, force field belt, and flight ring.

feats.claim: Withstood direct physical blows from heavy hitters like Doomsday using his 25th-century force field.

campaignTags.claim: Wears a 25th-century flight ring granting powered flight.
Employs futuristic gadgets like force field belts and energy gauntlets.
Uses time-travel technology for spatial and temporal relocation.

unknowns: Exact limits of the force field's energy capacity.

characters.summary: Brainiac is a hyper-intelligent extraterrestrial cyborg and collector of worlds who utilizes advanced technology, miniaturization beams, psychic attacks, and vast intellect to conquer civilizations.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to telepathic feedback and disruptions to his ship's central processing core
limitations: Often operates through remote drone bodies rather than engaging in direct hand-to-hand combat

sources.supports: Origins, shrinking cities, intellect, and technological prowess.

feats.claim: Successfully bottled and miniaturized the Kryptonian city of Kandor.

campaignTags.claim: Enhanced with extensive extraterrestrial cybernetics.
Possesses vast mental and telepathic dominance over others.
Can subjugate entire populations mentally.

unknowns: Full extent of his psychic range without amplification hardware.

characters.summary: Nathaniel Adam is infused with quantum energy, granting him immense powers including energy manipulation, matter creation, flight, and superhuman durability. He can absorb and project vast amounts of energy.
weaknesses: Breaches in his metallic containment skin can cause catastrophic quantum explosions
limitations: Requires careful internal energy regulation to prevent volatile meltdowns

sources.supports: Origin, quantum powers, Dilustel skin, and energy projection.

feats.claim: Absorbed and redirected a city-destroying energy blast without sustaining damage.

campaignTags.claim: Can fly at hypersonic speeds using quantum energy.
Manipulates and projects high-energy electrical and quantum discharges.

unknowns: Upper boundaries of his matter transmutation capabilities.

characters.continuity: DC Comics Modern Post-Crisis / New 52 / Rebirth
characters.summary: Leonard Snart is a master criminal who wields a scientifically engineered cold gun capable of absolute zero temperatures. He relies on tactical planning, leadership of the Rogues, and precise placement of ice fields to neutralize opponents.
weaknesses: Human physiology without his cold gun or protective gear
Prone to strict adherence to criminal code which can limit tactical flexibility
limitations: Cold gun requires maintenance and re-charging of cryogenic canisters

sources.supports: Cold gun mechanics, leadership of the Rogues, and absolute zero capabilities.

feats.claim: Froze molecules to absolute zero, successfully stopping objects moving at superhuman speeds.

campaignTags.claim: Manipulates ambient temperature and creates localized ice structures.
Wields a specialized cold gun that projects absolute zero temperatures.
Uses high-tech cryogenic weaponry and gear.

unknowns: Exact chemical composition of his proprietary cold weapon coolant.

characters.summary: Cassandra Cain is a master martial artist trained from birth to read body language and physical micro-expressions, allowing her to anticipate opponents' moves before they make them. She fights with exceptional hand-to-hand combat skill and stealth.

mechanisms: Body language reading for preemptive dodging

weaknesses: Limited verbal communication skills in early training can be exploited by psychological confusion
Human physical vulnerability to bullets and heavy energy attacks
limitations: Relies entirely on physical conditioning and martial arts without superhuman powers

sources.supports: Training as an assassin, body language reading, and martial arts mastery.

feats.claim: Defeated experienced martial artists like Lady Shiva and Batman in hand-to-hand combat.

notableResults.note: Defeated Shiva in single combat by exploiting her reading of physical movement.

campaignTags.claim: Expert assassin trained in silent movement and infiltration.
Executes stealth operations and covert intrusions.

unknowns: Full extent of her combat adaptability against non-human biological opponents.

characters.continuity: DC Comics Modern Post-Crisis / New 52 / Rebirth
characters.summary: Selina Kyle is a master cat burglar and skilled hand-to-hand combatant who utilizes a bullwhip, climbing claws, and stealth to execute high-profile thefts and navigate urban environments.
weaknesses: Standard human physical durability against heavy trauma or firearms

sources.supports: Skills as a burglar, whip mastery, and combat agility.

feats.claim: Infiltrated heavily guarded vaults in Wayne Enterprises undetected.

campaignTags.claim: Master thief specializing in undetected infiltration and burglary.
Breaches secure facilities using stealth and climbing gear.

unknowns: Exact security bypass methods used for high-end alien vaults.
